question: Why is the critique of external objects not examined again here?
premises: This point has already been stated earlier.
It is therefore not examined again in detail.
Many refutations of external objects have already been composed.
inference: Because the refutation of external objects was already established earlier and elaborated by many, it need not be reexamined here.
